entities.name: Wandel durch Handel
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Wandel durch Handel, also known as Wandel durch Annäherung, is a political and economic notion, mostly associated with German foreign policy, of increasing trade with authoritarian regimes in an effort to induce political change. Although most strongly associated with Germany, similar policies have been pursued by several Western countries. Wandel durch Handel is a political philosophy.
